<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1/sources/{id}/documents"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Accepts one or more documents for a push-provider source (see POST /sources with provider_type=push) and enqueues each for ingest through the same index/claim/extract path a pulled document takes. Returns 202 Accepted: the document rows exist and their raw bytes are retained, but nothing has been normalised, indexed or extracted yet. Poll GET /api/v1/documents/\{id\} and read ingest_status ("processing" / "indexed" / "failed") to find out when a document became searchable. Re-pushing the same external_id is idempotent and returns the same document_id. Admin only - see the RequireAdmin wiring at setupRoutes for why a pushing service's m2m token must resolve to a users row with Role=admin. Bytes travel base64-encoded in JSON; see the doc comment body below for why that was chosen over multipart/form-data. Body limited to pushDocumentMaxBodyBytes (larger than the default 10 MiB, since base64 inflates size by roughly a third).

Re-pushing the same ExternalID updates the\nexisting document rather than creating a duplicate.","type":"string"},"group":{"description":"Group is the document's partition key on a group-partitioned corpus:\nthe client, entity or fund it belongs to.\n\nREQUIRED when a claiming corpus declares PARTITION BY GROUP. A push\nsource has one root container and no hierarchy, so a pushed document\nderives no folder segments and would otherwise key to the empty string,\nwhich means \"visible to every partition\". There is no safe default, so\nan ungrouped document is rejected rather than filed arbitrarily.\n\nRejected when no claiming corpus is group-partitioned, so a caller\nsending a group to a folder-partitioned corpus learns it is not\npartitioning the way they think rather than having it silently ignored.\nEnforced in resolveGroupKeys, not here: only the service knows which\ncorpora end up claiming the document.\n\nStored with the document even when no corpus claims it yet, so a\ngroup-partitioned corpus created later claims it under this group\nrather than finding it ungrouped. Validated at accept for that reason.","type":"string"},"metadata":{"description":"Metadata is optional connector-agnostic key/value metadata.","type":"object","additionalProperties":{"type":"string"}},"mime_type":{"description":"MimeType drives normaliser dispatch (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML,\nMarkdown, plain text, ...). Required, and deliberately not inferred from\nlen(documents): a caller pushing exactly one document from a poll\ncycle that will send more shortly may still want \"batch\" semantics,\nand a caller forwarding many latency-sensitive events one at a time\nmay still want \"single\" semantics for each. See driving.IngestMode's\ndoc comment for the full reasoning.","type":"string"}}}}},"description":"Documents to push","required":true}}
